why_chain.text: Over the two days Agilent went from $169.09 to $170.54 (+0.86%): -0.54% on Thursday, +1.41% on Friday. Both moves were smaller than its usual daily range of about 3.0%.

Almost all of it came from the market and the health-care sector. Thursday: market -0.61, health care +0.03, Agilent +0.04. Friday: market +0.86, health care +0.81, Agilent -0.26. Over both days: market +0.25, health care +0.84, Agilent -0.23 (z-score -0.09).

Thursday's intraday drop (to -3.41%) was shared across health care: XLV, Thermo Fisher, Danaher, Waters, Revvity and Eli Lilly all opened lower, hit lows of -2% to -5% by midday, and recovered from about 1 p.m. while the S&P 500 kept slipping.

No tier-1 or tier-2 source explaining health care's weak Thursday open was found. Search results that blamed pharma tariffs were about April 2025 and were discarded. Pages that blamed Lilly profit-taking or GLP-1 price erosion were auto-generated (avoid tier). One recap claimed XLV rose 0.64% on Thursday, which contradicts the price data (-0.39%).
